facts.text: The hotel is at 7 Nine Elms Lane, London SW8 5PH.
facts.excerpt: 7 Nine Elms Lane, London, SW8 5PH, United Kingdom

facts.text: The hotel is located in Nine Elms, a residential district in London.
facts.excerpt: Located in Nine Elms, a popular residential district in the heart of London

facts.text: The hotel is close to Big Ben, Buckingham Palace, Tate Britain, Battersea Park, Sloane Square and the King's Road.
facts.excerpt: situated close to all the nearby attractions like Big Ben, Buckingham Palace, Tate Britain, Battersea Park, Sloane Square and Kings Road

facts.text: The lobby features a Charlie Whinney commission, Ebb and Flow, and Ian Rayer-Smith's Land and Water painting, both paying homage to the River Thames.
facts.excerpt: The lobby is adorned with a striking Charlie Whinney commission, Ebb and Flow, along with Ian Rayer-Smith's Land and Water painting that both pay homage to the River Thames.

facts.text: Work by 20 artists runs through the hotel's spaces.
facts.excerpt: 20 world renowned artists weave through the spaces of Park Hyatt London River Thames

facts.text: The spa has six treatment rooms and a riverside relaxation room with two Somadome Pods and sauna facilities.
facts.excerpt: a spa with six luxurious treatment rooms, a riverside relaxation room featuring two Somadome Pods and sauna facilities

facts.text: Guests can use an indoor heated pool and a double-height fitness centre.
facts.excerpt: Guests can enjoy an opulent indoor heated pool, a technologically advanced fitness centre with two-storey height

facts.text: Wellness facilities occupy a dedicated floor with natural daylight.
facts.excerpt: within our dedicated floor for wellness with ample natural daylight

facts.text: Yu Ge is the hotel's Cantonese restaurant, led by Head Chef Eng Soon Yeo.
facts.excerpt: Yú Gé at Park Hyatt London River Thames celebrates the artistry of Cantonese heritage. Guided by Head Chef Eng Soon Yeo

facts.text: Yu Ge is a riverside Cantonese restaurant inspired by imperial traditions from the Song dynasty.
facts.excerpt: An elegant riverside destination for authentic Cantonese dining, inspired by imperial traditions from the Song dynasty.

facts.text: Yu Ge serves Peking duck among its signature dishes.
facts.excerpt: presenting signature masterpieces like Peking duck

facts.text: The Nine Elms Kitchen focuses on British produce prepared in an open kitchen, with a dining room and terrace.
facts.excerpt: each dish tells a story of British produce at its finest, organically sourced, thoughtfully prepared in an open kitchen and served in an elegant dining room and terrace

facts.text: The Nine Elms Bar serves classic and inventive cocktails with small bites.
facts.excerpt: this inviting space at Park Hyatt London River Thames brings together timeless and inventive cocktails with delicate bites

facts.text: All guest rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows with city or river views.
facts.excerpt: All guest rooms seamlessly blend comfort and indulgence with plush bedding, fine amenities and floor-to-ceiling windows for breathtaking cityscapes or calming river views.

facts.text: The corner river-view rooms open onto a 90-degree view of the River Thames.
facts.excerpt: the room opens up to reveal a stunning 90-degree angle view of the River Thames

facts.text: Corner rooms have a wardrobe with William Morris wallpaper, reachable from both the bedroom and the bathroom.
facts.excerpt: the wardrobe, featuring incredible wallpaper by William Morris, is accessible from both the bedroom and the bathroom

facts.text: Bathrooms stock Blaise Mautin toiletries.
facts.excerpt: complete with luxurious Blaise Mautin toiletries

facts.text: The Ambassador Suite is reached by a private elevator to the VIP floor.
facts.excerpt: Accessed via a private elevator to the VIP floor

facts.text: The Family Room combines an accessible king room with a twin-bed room.
facts.excerpt: The Family Room combines an accessible king room with a twin-bed room to create a spacious retreat.

facts.text: Children can follow Froggy, the hotel's mascot, on a trail around the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Let your little ones follow Froggy, our playful mascot, on an exciting journey around the hotel.

facts.text: The hotel welcomes dogs.
facts.excerpt: We warmly welcome dogs.

facts.text: Valet parking is offered, subject to availability.
facts.excerpt: Park Hyatt London River Thames offers valet parking for our guests and visitors, subject to availability.

facts.text: The whole hotel can be booked as an exclusive venue for private events.
facts.excerpt: Transform Park Hyatt London River Thames into your exclusive venue for private events

facts.text: The hotel describes itself as a sanctuary of understated luxury.
facts.excerpt: Our sanctuary of understated luxury invites travellers into a world where the heritage of Nine Elms meets contemporary elegance.
